name: JW Marriott Hotel Nairobi
positioning: The tallest hotel in Kenya, a 35-story tower on Chiromo Lane in Westlands, Nairobi, with a heated fifth-floor infinity pool, Spa by JW and residences with full kitchens
best_for: Travelers who want skyline views from a high-rise in Westlands
Families and longer stays that want a residence with a full kitchen and separate living and dining areas
Guests who want a spa and a heated infinity pool in the city

facts.text: The hotel is on Chiromo Lane in Westlands, Nairobi.
The hotel rises 35 stories above the Westlands district.
The hotel is the tallest hotel in Kenya.
Interiors are inspired by local culture and landscapes.
Rooms and residences have large windows with views of the Central Business District and the Westlands entertainment hub.
Every guest room has a walk-in shower and a bathtub.
The JW Marriott Residences have fully equipped kitchens and separate living and dining areas.
Spa by JW has eight treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge, a steam room and a sauna.
The 24-hour fitness center has floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
Mr. Pang Sky Bar and Lounge serves Pan-Asian food and signature drinks with views.
The Nairobi National Museum is a short walk from the hotel.
The hotel is about 20 minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport via the Nairobi Expressway.

highlights.text: At 35 stories, it is the tallest hotel in Kenya.
A heated infinity pool on the fifth floor looks out over the skyline, with private cabanas.
Genuine African artwork is displayed around the hotel, and the pieces are available for purchase.
Nearby Nairobi National Park offers game drives with the city skyscrapers as a backdrop.

considerations.text: Mr. Pang and Mughal have a dress code that excludes shorts, sneakers, flip-flops and sportswear.
